Robust monitoring of model performance across different student groups *after* implementation will be critical, alongside clear opt-out procedures. Additionally, significant investment in advisor training to interpret outputs responsibly is essential – this isn’t just a technical fix; it requires skilled human intervention.

We also need to ensure advisors receive adequate training on interpreting the model’s output and communicating this effectively to students; simply having 'a flag' isn’t enough.
